body:
## [3.116.0] - 2026-11-25

### Features

- add vendor return warehouse configuration and search dialog

### Bug Fixes

- guard deferred ownership and clear-order recovery
- reconcile displayed refund VAT at currency precision
- limit recovery owner writes to voucher flows
- freeze recovery account before confirmation wait
- expose recovered vouchers and preserve original RFID evidence
- deliver confirmed credit while posting remains in review
- release saved orders before ancillary preparation
- share silent saved-order handoff and retain unfinished work
- release confirmed orders and verify recovered credit
- preserve mixed tenders and reserve recovery scans
- keep focus on scanner input to prevent cancellation during barcode lookup
- persist support evidence before parking checkout
- search company-compatible vendors
- keep deferred effects fair and validate exchange tags
- verify saved voucher partner when lookup is incomplete
- require online confirmation for restored payment intents
- hand desktop failures to support and preserve deferred work
- verify customer before issuing recovered credit
- retain historical confirmed credit compatibility
- publish phone credit only after sync confirmation
- release saved refunds pending review
- clear search errors after retry
- label unset return warehouse
- restore automatic return warehouse
- remove extra localization arguments
- include return warehouse in search
- lock source customer and verify currency amounts
- localize return destination settings
- refresh destination and product search
- include free loyalty products in receipt savings (AIONE-899)

### Other Changes

- declare raw-tag fixture after its helper
- cover retained activation repair and fuel handoff
- preserve localization formatting after dependency merge
- isolate quick customer tag widget fixture
- Keep receipt customer recovery desktop-only
- Before: Always rounded savings to 2 decimal places. Now: Uses the same precision as checkout—for example, 0 decimals for JPY, 3 for KWD, and 2 for ILS. Applies that precision to both tax calculations and the final savings amount.
- Fill missing refund customer from the original Odoo receipt
- Complete refund vouchers before acknowledging recovered orders
- Updated the savings block to match the example’s layout: - Centered label and amount on separate lines. - Larger, medium-weight font. - Extra spacing below the product count.Reverted the phone-printer savings changes and related tests. The shared calculation, setting, and standard receipt changes remain.
- Implemented Print Savings on Purchase, default disabled.
